blurb: Introducing Hirondelle Estate, a quiet, secluded oasis.The 200-acre intimate estate is located 1 hour west of Toronto, just east of Guelph. The grounds are responsibly stewarded. Nature prospers here, with sustainably planted crops, protected trees and forests, wildflower gardens, horses, chickens, bees, butterflies, and birds.
